Loss of offsite power.provides: loss of normal AC power, no primary circuit breach, immediate demand on diesels

Steam generator tube rupture.requires: a breach between primary and secondary circuits
Steam generator tube rupture.provides: a direct path bypassing containment, primary coolant loss, radioactive release route

Reactor coolant pump trip.provides: reduced heat removal, no breach, natural circulation available

Control rod ejection.requires: failure of a control rod housing under pressure
Control rod ejection.provides: rapid reactivity insertion, localised fuel damage, primary breach at the housing

Emergency diesel generators.provides: restoration of power to safety buses, no cooling function itself

Emergency core cooling injection.requires: loss of coolant inventory or pressure
Emergency core cooling injection.provides: makeup water to the core, only meaningful when inventory is lost

Reactor protection system scram.requires: a parameter exceeding its trip setpoint
Reactor protection system scram.provides: termination of the chain reaction within seconds, no effect on decay heat

Containment isolation.requires: a signal indicating release inside containment
Containment isolation.provides: closure of penetrations, useless against a path that bypasses containment

Manual scram.requires: an operator and a reactor that is critical
Manual scram.provides: immediate shutdown, no effect if already shut down

Feed and bleed cooling.requires: loss of normal heat sink and available injection
Feed and bleed cooling.provides: heat removal at the cost of deliberate coolant discharge

Isolate the affected loop.requires: a fault confined to one identifiable loop
Isolate the affected loop.provides: termination of the leak path, reduced cooling capacity

Monitor and take no action.provides: no operator-induced error, no correction of anything automatic systems miss

Full power operation.requires: the reactor critical at rated output
Full power operation.provides: maximum decay heat, maximum stored energy, all systems in service

Low power startup.requires: the reactor critical at low output
Low power startup.provides: low decay heat, reduced margins, some systems not yet in service

Cold shutdown.provides: low decay heat, no scram possible, residual heat removal in service

Refuelling outage.requires: the vessel head removed and fuel being moved
Refuelling outage.provides: no reactor operation at all, open containment, fuel handling hazards only

Release inside containment only.requires: a primary breach with containment intact

Minor release to environment.requires: a bypass path or partial containment failure
Minor release to environment.provides: measurable offsite dose, no protective action needed

Significant release to environment.requires: major fuel damage plus a bypass or containment failure

_v1_notes.INITIATING EVENT|SAFETY SYSTEM DEMANDED: diesels are demanded only by loss of offsite power. Core cooling injection is demanded by inventory loss, so N for loss of power and pump trip. Containment isolation is N for loss of power, tube rupture (which bypasses containment entirely) and pump trip; Y only for rod ejection.
_v1_notes.INITIATING EVENT|OPERATOR ACTION: loop isolation is N for loss of offsite power and pump trip - no loop is leaking. Feed and bleed is N for tube rupture (the leak is the problem, not the heat sink) and N for pump trip. Rod ejection is N for isolation and N for no-action.
_v1_notes.INITIATING EVENT|PLANT STATE: tube rupture, pump trip and rod ejection are all N in cold shutdown and refuelling - the primary circuit is not at pressure and the reactor is not operating.
_v1_notes.INITIATING EVENT|RADIOLOGICAL CONSEQUENC: loss of offsite power and pump trip cause no breach, so anything beyond no-release is N. Tube rupture and rod ejection can reach any level.
_v1_notes.SAFETY SYSTEM DEMANDED|OPERATOR ACTION: diesels x isolate loop is N. Containment isolation x manual scram is N as a paired action.
_v1_notes.SAFETY SYSTEM DEMANDED|PLANT STATE: core cooling injection is N during refuelling. Scram is N in cold shutdown and refuelling - the reactor is already subcritical, there is nothing to scram.
_v1_notes.SAFETY SYSTEM DEMANDED|RADIOLOGICAL CONS: diesels are N for every release category - restoring power causes no release. Scram is N for minor and significant release.
_v1_notes.OPERATOR ACTION|PLANT STATE: manual scram and feed and bleed are both N in cold shutdown and refuelling.
_v1_notes.OPERATOR ACTION|RADIOLOGICAL CONSEQUENCE: manual scram is N for minor and significant release - a successful scram does not produce them.
_v1_notes.PLANT STATE|RADIOLOGICAL CONSEQUENCE: cold shutdown and refuelling are N for minor and significant environmental release as posed.
